minimal_reproduction: The caller follows v2.3 and supplies only J1 and a perfect adapter output.
The fixed root selects the exact v2.2 J1 evaluator contract.
That contract requires PINNED_CONTRACT_PRESENTED_BY_CALLER for PASS.
v2.3 forbids caller-presented contract, so the predicate is false and the exact algebra requires FAIL_CLOSED.
major_finding.why_no_local_patch: Ignoring the predicate would stop applying the exact root-bound contract; allowing caller presentation would reopen the previous whole-chain replacement vulnerability.

closed_other_checks: The build-time root path, SHA-256 and byte length are fixed and non-overridable by the caller.
Source-relative resolution ignores cwd, environment and runtime configuration.
Caller surface is lane plus adapter output only, with wrong or extra inputs rejected.
History, NOT_TESTED, no cross-lane composition, no qualification and no authority remain correct.

declared_options: Use a single directly build-time-owned per-lane evaluator, oracle and configuration without inheriting the contradictory v2.2 contract.
Stop the model-qualification branch and use a human-reviewed or deterministic reality experiment.
stall_and_backtrack.portfolio_recommendation: Prefer stopping the model-qualification branch now because exact-context conformance does not reduce source-interpretation, demand, buyer or willingness-to-pay uncertainty; retain the per-lane evaluator as backlog rather than a reality-feedback prerequisite.
